REGISTRATIONS CLOSE 2 DAYS PRIOR TO THE DATE OF THE EXAM. The students whose administrative situation is irregular (like the payment of some installment still wanting) can put their name in the list, but are not admitted to the exam. An irregular position is made visible in the list by the red dot on the left. Students whose situation is irregular are kindly requested not to insist about being admitted to the exam.
